Northern Steppe Assurance LLP
Kenesary Street 47, Astana, Kazakhstan
Independent Auditor's Report
To the Shareholders of Ereymentau Energy Holding JSC:
We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Ereymentau Energy Holding JSC and its
subsidiaries, which comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31 December 2025,
and the consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year then
ended. In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all
material respects, the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2025 in
accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards.
